Boeing, through its wholly owned subsidiary Spirit AeroSystems, designs and builds commercial aerostructures for the aviation industry. The Entry-Level Software Engineer will coordinate requirements and schedules, implement software design changes and application updates, support testing and deployment, and provide training and technical assistance to users.

Perform weekly status review
Define schedule milestones based on customer needs
Provide regular progress report to leadership
Implement design changes/application updates
Assist in testing and deployment
Assist in providing training to the user group
Extend technical support to user group during the deployment phase

Required
Requires a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or another related field from an ABET-accredited program
1+ years of relevant software development experience
Experience and/or college projects using modern programing languages (for example, C#, Visual Studio, Java, etc.)
“U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. 120.15 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee
Preferred
Related technical experience
Experience using C#, WPF, ASP.Net Core, Blazor, Visual Studio or Azure DevOps/TFS
Basic understanding of CAD/CAM/CAE computer aided engineering packages
Basic understanding of a typical aircraft structure fabrication and assembly processes
Demonstrated application development and software Product Lifecycle management experience in authoring, installation, and deployments
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to proactively identify issues, find root cause and identify both temporary and permanent solutions
Ability to comprehend complex software, hardware, and networking concepts
Demonstrated experience conducting formal Root Cause Analysis and implementing Corrective Action
Experience participating in technical teams with diverse backgrounds
Ability to manage and organize multiple tasks with frequent interruptions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
